messages:
sam (Sales): AcmeBank procurement emailed — they want SOC 2 Type II, ISO27001 cert, a pen-test letter, and a signed attestation for the POC. Deadline they gave: EOD Fri CET. Can we assemble a compliance bundle?

nina (SE): @sam (Sales) I'll own the bundle. Quick Q: do we have an up-to-date redacted SOC2 and the ISO cert we can send? They also asked for a network diagram for the private deployment and a short list of deployed controls.

alex (InfoSec): @nina (SE) We have a redacted SOC2 Type II and ISO certificate PDF. Last pen test was 2025-11-12 by BlueWave Security (external blackbox). I can draft a pen-test attestation letter and a one-page redacted summary. Full report requires vendor and legal sign-off.

tara (Legal): @alex (InfoSec) Please confirm BlueWave's agreement allows a redacted summary. For the attestation, I'll need to review liability language. Also we should include a DPA/data residency statement — they specifically asked about EU-at-rest for the POC.

ops-oncall: @nina (SE) pulling the private/VPC network diagram now. Command I used to export: ```curl -H "Authorization: Bearer $CI_TOKEN" "https://internal-graph/api/diagram?env=private&format=svg" -o acme_private_diagram.svg```

nina (SE): Thanks @ops-oncall. Procurement asked that the pen-test letter be addressed to procurement@acmebank.com and explicitly reference the 'redwood-private' deployment scope. @alex (InfoSec) can you include vendor name + test date + scope summary in the draft?

alex (InfoSec): Yes — drafting. Proposed short template below (will iterate with Legal):
```
To: Procurement@acmebank.com
Subject: Penetration Test Attestation — Redwood Inference

This letter confirms that BlueWave Security conducted an external (blackbox) penetration test of Redwood Inference's production public endpoints and private deployment orchestration on 2025-11-12. No critical findings were identified; remaining findings were remediated as of 2025-12-10. A redacted summary is attached for procurement review. This attestation is provided for procurement purposes and excludes full technical details to protect security.

Signed,
Alex Rivera
Head of Information Security
Redwood Inference
```

tara (Legal): Looks good. Please replace 'excludes full technical details to protect security' with: 'is provided for procurement review and excludes full technical details to protect our customers and infrastructure'. Also add: 'This letter is issued at the request of the recipient and is not a warranty or guarantee of security.' I'll review the final draft before signing.

sam (Sales): :thumbsup: Target sending the bundle by Thu EOD to give them time. Action items:
- @nina (SE): assemble SOC2 redacted PDF, ISO cert, attestation, network diagram, pen-test letter draft
- @alex (InfoSec): finalize pen-test letter + redacted summary
- @tara (Legal): final review + signature
- @ops-oncall: export diagram + provide list of deployed controls
Any blockers?

evidence-bot: Reminder: For outbound security artifacts, attach as password-protected PDF or ZIP and upload to secure-sales-bucket. Use one-time link TTL=7d.

nina (SE): I'll package as a password-protected zip and upload to secure-sales. I'll include a short README with what we redacted in the pen-test summary.

alex (InfoSec): One note: if Acme requests the full penetration report we need an NDA and vendor approval — we'll route that through Legal and BlueWave. Flagging now in case procurement pushes back.

sam (Sales): Good call. I'll confirm with procurement that redacted materials + attestation suffice and ask if they'll sign an NDA for the full report if requested.

ops-oncall: Export complete. Diagram saved to secure-sales-bucket as acme_private_diagram.svg. Commands and upload notes: ```
# export
curl -H "Authorization: Bearer $CI_TOKEN" "https://internal-graph/api/diagram?env=private&format=svg" -o acme_private_diagram.svg
# upload
aws s3 cp acme_private_diagram.svg s3://secure-sales/acme/ --sse aws:kms
```

tara (Legal): I'll prepare the signed attestation template and reach out to BlueWave to confirm permission to share the redacted summary. Will copy procurement if needed.

nina (SE): Thanks all — assembling now. I'll post the secure link here once the package is uploaded and Tara signs the attestation.
